kebab_example: aliyun gws describe-instances --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id gws-xxx --instance-id i-xxx --user-uid 12345 --user-name user01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en: The number of instances per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Lists all instances in the specified cluster ID.
If this parameter is not specified, instances in all clusters are listed
parameters.help_zh:
列出指定集群 id 中的所有实例。
如果此参数未指定，则列出所有集群中的实例
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Lists the information of the specified instance ID.
If this parameter is not specified, all instances are listed
parameters.help_zh:
列出实例 id 的信息。
如果此参数未指定，则列出所有实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Lists all instances assigned to the specified user ID.
If this parameter is not specified, instances of all users are listed
parameters.help_zh:
列出分配给指定用户 id 的所有实例。
如果此参数未指定，则列出所有用户的实例
parameters.name: user_uid

parameters.help_en:
Lists all instances assigned to the specified user.
If this parameter is not specified, instances of all users are listed
parameters.help_zh:
列出分配给指定用户的所有实例。
如果此参数未指定，则列出所有用户的实例
parameters.name: user_name

AppList.description_en:
The application list.

This list is empty when the work mode is `Desktop`
AppList.description_zh:
应用列表。

工作模式为`桌面模式`时，此列表为空

AppArgs.description_en: The runtime parameters of the application

AppPath.description_en: The runtime path of the application

DomainName.description_en: The user Active Directory (AD) associated with the cluster to which the instance belongs. This value is empty when the cluster is not associated with an AD or the cluster does not support AD association
DomainName.description_zh: 实例所在的集群所关联的用户 AD。当集群未做 AD 关联或集群不支持 AD 关联时，此值为空

HostName.description_en: The hostname, which is automatically generated when the instance is created. Do not change it. Otherwise, the instance status becomes "Unregistered"
HostName.description_zh: 主机名称，实例创建时自动生成。不可更改，否则会导致实例状态“未注册”

ImageId.description_en: The image ID used when the instance was created
ImageId.description_zh: 实例创建时所使用的镜像 id

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
InstanceChargeType.description_zh:
计费方式：
PrePaid：包年包月
PostPaid：按量付费

IsBoundUser.description_en:
Indicates whether the current caller is assigned to the current instance. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
IsBoundUser.description_zh:
当前调用者是否已分配给当前实例
true：是
false：否

MaxBandwidthIn.description_en: The maximum inbound Internet bandwidth, in Mbit/s
MaxBandwidthIn.description_zh: 公网入带宽最大值，单位为 Mbps

MaxBandwidthOut.description_en: The maximum outbound Internet bandwidth, in Mbit/s
MaxBandwidthOut.description_zh: 公网出带宽最大值，单位为 Mbps

Name.description_en: The instance name, which can be set by the user
Name.description_zh: 实例名称，用户可以自行设置

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Creating: being created
Starting: being started
Stopping: being stopped
Stopped: stopped
Initializing: being initialized
Unregistered: unregistered
Registered: registered
InUse: in use
Missing: missing
Cloning: image being created
Status.description_zh:
实例状态：
Creating：创建中
Starting：启动中
Stopping：停止中
Stopped：已停止
Initializing：初始化
Unregistered：未注册
Registered：已注册
InUse：使用中
Missing：丢失
Cloning：镜像制作中

StoppedMode.description_en:
The billing status when the instance is stopped. Valid values:
KeepCharging: Billing continues. For example, the user shuts down the instance from within Windows.
StopCharging: Billing stops.
Not-applicable: Not applicable. For example, subscription instances
StoppedMode.description_zh:
实例停止时的计费状态。
KeepCharging：收费中，例如用户通过 Windows 内部关机
StopCharging：停止收费
Not-applicable：不适用。例如包年包月实例

UserName.description_en:
The assigned username.

This value is empty when the instance is not assigned to a specified user
UserName.description_zh:
分配的用户名。

实例未分配给指定用户时，此值为空

UserUid.description_en:
The assigned user ID.

This value is empty when the instance is not assigned to a specified user
UserUid.description_zh:
分配的用户 id

实例未分配给指定用户时，此值为空

WorkMode.description_en:
The work mode. Valid values:
Desktop: desktop mode
Application: application mode
WorkMode.description_zh:
工作模式
Desktop：桌面模式
Application：应用模式

PageSize.description_en: The number of rows per page
